sections.head: Test the voice agents behind your IVR

items.a: IVR testing checks that an interactive voice response system answers calls, understands key presses and speech, plays the right prompts and routes callers correctly.

items.q: How do you automate IVR testing?
items.a: TestMu AI places real calls with AI callers that press DTMF keys and speak, then scores each call and records audio and transcripts.

items.q: Can TestMu AI load test an IVR?
items.a: Yes. Inbound load tests run sustained call volume and report where quality or capacity breaks.
Over 30 metrics per call, including intent recognition, prompt accuracy, routing, transfer success and wait time.

items.q: Does it work with any IVR vendor?
items.a: Yes. Tests run over the phone network, so they work with any IVR you can call.
